# Load R packages

```{r setup}
# generate output data folder
if(
  !dir.exists(here::here("data", "output"))
  ) dir.create(here::here("data", "output"))

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(labelled)
library(haven)
library(knitr)
library(assertthat)
library(tibble)
library(sf)
library(janitor)
library(stringr)
library(scales)
library(naniar)
library(countrycode)
library(purrr)
library(testthat)
```
